channel.description: Recent content in AWS on Shantanu's Portfolio

item.title: Automated AWS Network Infrastructure
item.description: Designed and provisioned a secure VPC architecture using Terraform IaC modules.

item.title: Advanced Cloud & GitOps Implementations
item.description: This portfolio showcases recent hands-on projects, including a GitOps deployment pipeline on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with ArgoCD, a fully Terraform-codified AWS serverless CI/CD architecture, and an EKS-based three-tier e-commerce platform integrating Jenkins and ArgoCD.

item.title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Projects
item.description: This portfolio highlights recent hands-on projects, including a GitOps deployment pipeline on AKS, a Terraform-codified AWS serverless CI/CD architecture, and an EKS-based e-commerce platform, alongside extensive experience with Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and observability tools.

item.title: Recent DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Projects
item.description: This portfolio highlights recent hands-on projects including a GitOps deployment pipeline on AKS, a Terraform-codified AWS serverless CI/CD architecture, and an EKS-based e-commerce platform, showcasing expertise in modern DevOps and cloud infrastructure.

item.title: Automated AWS CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Integration
item.description: This project details the creation of a zero-touch CI/CD pipeline on AWS, integrating GitHub, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, S3, and CloudFront for automated deployments. It highlights the troubleshooting of an IAM permission issue during the build process.

item.title: End-to-End AWS CI/CD Pipeline
item.description: This project details the creation of a fully automated, end-to-end CI/CD pipeline on AWS, integrating GitHub for source control with AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, S3, and CloudFront for seamless global content delivery.

item.title: End-to-End AWS CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub
item.description: This project details the creation of a zero-touch, end-to-end CI/CD pipeline on AWS, integrating GitHub, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, S3, and CloudFront for automated deployments and global content delivery.

item.title: Building Secure Static Website Hosting with AWS S3 & CloudFront
item.description: This project details the creation of a secure static website hosting architecture using Amazon S3 and CloudFront, highlighting key learnings from common configuration pitfalls related to access control and routing.

item.title: Secure Static Website Hosting with AWS S3 & CloudFront
item.description: Built a secure static website hosting architecture leveraging Amazon S3 for storage and Amazon CloudFront for global content delivery, overcoming common configuration challenges related to access control and routing.

item.title: Building a GitOps Microservices Architecture on AWS
item.description: This project details the implementation of an end-to-end DevOps Microservices architecture on AWS, leveraging a GitOps workflow with Terraform, AWS EKS, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD. It highlights key challenges encountered during deployment and their practical solutions.

item.title: Building a Cloud and DevOps Portfolio
item.description: This portfolio showcases hands-on experience in provisioning AWS infrastructure with Terraform, establishing automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, and deploying 3-tier applications on Azure Kubernetes Service.
